info.name: Secure Connect API
info.description: Manual-authentication, personal notes, admin RBAC, and health-check tests for Secure Connect Platform. Select the Secure Connect Local environment and run requests in order.

exec: pm.test('Response contains safe public user fields', function () { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.username).to.eql(pm.environment.get('username')); pm.expect(body.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('userEmail')); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('password'); });
pm.test('Current-user route is protected and successful', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Current user has expected ID and no password hash', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('userId')); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('password'); });
pm.test('Missing token is rejected with 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Error explains missing token', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('No token provided'); });

pm.test('Created note belongs to authenticated user', function () { pm.expect(body._id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.owner).to.eql(pm.environment.get('userId')); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql('My First Note'); });
pm.test('Notes list returns 200 and an array', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('List only contains the current user\'s notes', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (note) { pm.expect(note.owner).to.eql(pm.environment.get('userId')); }); });
pm.test('Returned note ID matches noteId', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()._id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('noteId')); });

pm.test('Updated fields are returned', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql('Updated First Note'); pm.expect(body.content).to.eql('This is my updated note.'); });
pm.test('Deletion is acknowledged', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Note deleted successfully'); });
pm.test('Admin can list users', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('User list never includes password hashes', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (user) { pm.expect(user).not.to.have.property('password'); }); });
pm.test('Statistics include user and note counts', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.users).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.notes).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Regular user is denied admin access', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
